I'm Isabelle Garza, a business, marketing, and analytics student at California State Polytechnic University, Pomona. I'm passionate about building a portfolio that brings together my academic and applied work across data science, marketing strategy, enterprise systems, and business analytics.

## Academic Profile

My coursework reflects a broad business education with emphasis in marketing management, promotional strategy, consumer behavior, market analysis, business analytics, finance, management information systems, and communication. I have completed hands-on work with:

- **R & the Tidyverse** — Data visualization with ggplot2, data wrangling with dplyr/tidyr, interactive visualizations with Plotly, functional programming with purrr
- **SAP Enterprise Systems** — Financial Accounting (FI), Sales & Distribution (SD), Materials Management (MM), and Production Planning (PP)
- **Analytics Tools** — Tableau 2024.1, Excel PivotTables, Google Analytics, and statistical analysis
- **Programming** — Python fundamentals, R programming, and data-driven decision making
